title: Locality of module properties on a binary union
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W,V$ opens and $G$ a module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on $W\cup V$. If its restrictions to both $W$ and $V$ are quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], then $G$ is quasi-coherent and of finite type. No compactness or affineness assumption is made.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (lemma-extend), binary gluing paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: Use the iterated-slice equivalence to transport each restricted module to the iterated restriction of G. The equivalence preserves the unit and colimits, so it transports presentations and finite generating families. Finite type is invariant under isomorphisms by transporting the generating epimorphisms.

The two opens, indexed by ULift Bool, cover the union site: intersect every test open with W or V. Apply Mathlib IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop. For finite type, combine local-generators data over this cover with the iterated-slice equivalence, then shrink the index type and use IsFiniteType.mk.

proof_origin.note: Concrete Lean implementation of the cited gluing paragraph; local properties also follow Definitions 01BE and 01B5, read on the Stacks website.

mathlib_searches.query: Restriction to an open of the pullback of a module sheaf along the direct image of a submodule
Quasi coherence and finite type of sheaves of modules are local on a cover of two opens

from.place: Affine-union construction: binary submodule gluing; Locality of module properties on a binary union

lean.statement:
theorem module_binary_local_properties
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (W ⊔ V)))
    (hW : ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_left))).obj G).IsQuasicoherent ∧
      ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_left))).obj G).IsFiniteType)
    (hV : ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (show V ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_right))).obj G).IsQuasicoherent ∧
      ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (show V ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_right))).obj G).IsFiniteType) :
    G.IsQuasicoherent ∧ G.IsFiniteType
